description_en: You can invoke ChangeWorkMode to change the agent's work mode
description_zh: 调用ChangeWorkMode改变坐席的工作模式
kebab_example: aliyun ccc change-work-mode --instance-id ccc-test --work-mode ON_SITE --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeWorkMode

parameters.help_en: Agent ID. If not specified, the agent mapped to the current Resource Access Management (RAM) user is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 坐席ID，不填默认使用当前RAM账号映射的坐席
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: Device ID, which is the identity ID of a browser-based Web Real-Time Communication (WebRTC) softphone or a physical phone device. Only one type of device can be registered at a time
parameters.help_zh: 设备ID，浏览器WebRTC软电话或实体话机设备的标识ID，同一时间只允许一种设备注册
parameters.name: device_id

parameters.help_en: List of skill groups to sign in to. When changing the work mode to off-site mode, you can use this parameter to specify the list of skill groups that the off-site agent needs to sign in to
parameters.help_zh: 需要签入的技能组列表。当修改工作模式到场外模式时，可以通过此参数指定场外座席需要签入的技能组列表
parameters.name: signed_skill_group_id_list

parameters.help_en: The agent's personal phone number, which is used in off-site mode. The agent can use this number to answer calls in off-site mode
parameters.help_zh: 坐席的个人电话号码，该号码在场外模式下会用到，坐席可以使用该号码进行场外模式接听
parameters.name: mobile

BreakCode.description_en: Break status code, which can be either System-defined or Custom-defined. System-defined break codes include: Warm-up (temporary break state after agent is published and before becoming idle), RingingTimeout (break caused by agent ringing timeout), and RejectCall (break caused by agent rejecting a call). There are no restrictions on Custom-defined status codes; customers can define them according to their business needs
BreakCode.description_zh:
小休状态码，分为系统定义的和客户定义的两种，系统定义的小休码包括：Warm-up
（坐席上线后置闲前的临时小休状态）、RingingTimeout（坐席振铃超时导致的小休）、RejectCall（坐席拒接导致的小休）。客户自定义状态码没有限制，客户可以根据业务需要自行定义

enumValueTitles.RingingTimeout: 坐席振铃超时导致的小休
enumValueTitles.Warm-up: 坐席上线后置闲前的临时小休状态

DeviceId.description_en: Device ID, which is the identity of a browser-based Web Real-Time Communication (WebRTC) softphone or a physical phone device. Only one type of device can be registered at a time
DeviceId.description_zh: 设备ID，浏览器WebRTC软电话或实体话机设备的标识ID，同一时间只允许一种设备注册

JobId.description_en: Call ID. If this field has a value, the agent is currently in a call
JobId.description_zh: 通话ID，如果该字段有值，说明坐席当前处于通话过程中

OutboundScenario.description_en: Indicates whether the agent has enabled outbound-only mode
OutboundScenario.description_zh: 坐席是否开启了仅外呼模式

SignedSkillGroupIdList.description_en: List of skill group IDs that the agent has signed into
SignedSkillGroupIdList.description_zh: 坐席签入的技能组ID列表
